{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
# Keep only completed orders with valid revenue (not QA)
filtered_data = data[
    (data['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Check the filtered data
print(f'Filtered data shape: {filtered_data.shape}')
print(f'Unique channels: {filtered_data['channel'].unique()}')

# Calculate total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = filtered_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue by channel:\n{total_revenue_by_channel}')

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.max()
print(f'Channel with highest revenue: {best_channel} with ${max_revenue:,.2f}')"}
